title: Foundations: normalized records and adapter contract
description:
Purpose: build the source-agnostic core that every adapter and the meter depend on. Everything else in the initiative blocks on this epic.

Scope: shared HumanMessageRecord (source, session id, record id, project path, UTC timestamp, role, text, dedup key, provenance) as a Zod schema; the adapter contract (discover/extract, streaming, skip-and-count failure policy); the dedup-key and union framework; the incremental scan-state store; the synthetic fixture corpus skeleton.

Done when: the record schema and adapter contract are exported from the scanner public API; malformed/unknown records are skipped and counted without failing a scan; dedup collapses identical records across copies; scan state holds only watermarks and fingerprints (never message text); tests/fixtures/sentiment/ exists with per-source subtrees; all unit tests pass.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: All five foundation tasks closed: record schema + timestamp normalization, adapter contract with skip-with-counter policy, dedup-key/union framework, incremental scan-state store, and the synthetic fixture corpus skeleton. All exported via src/index.ts; 29 unit tests green; fixtures under tests/fixtures/sentiment/ with the no-real-transcripts README rule.
